description: Redesign P2.1 (Flutter): renames the pre-redesign catch_ui callers of CatchSurface, CatchText and CatchTextVariant to CatchLegacySurface, CatchLegacyText and CatchLegacyTextVariant, and the moved files' paths, under lib, apps, packages/*/lib and test, test, integration_test, widgetbook/lib and tool/ui_capture. One-shot: --check and the rename run by hand on branches cut before the first caller of the system components; CI runs only its tests.
reason: The redesign P2.1 rename landed on main: the pre-redesign components live on as CatchLegacy*, and the system components now own the old names, so this codemod's --check reports correct callers and running it would break them. design:library-shims ratchets the legacy residue. Its callers moved to CatchLegacySurface, CatchLegacyText and CatchLegacyTextVariant.
